reader_summary.headline: This is Matt Reustle and today we’re breaking down Diploma.
reader_summary.overview: This is Matt Reustle and today we’re breaking down Diploma. Diploma is a specialist distributor of medical equipment and industrial components listed in the UK. It’s a business you’re unlikely to be familiar with and, at first glance, may appear mundane.

key_points.text: But dig a little deeper and you’ll find a high-quality operator generating significant free cash flow through a mix of organic and inorganic growth channels..
To break down Diploma, I’m joined by Charlie Huggins, an investor in the business and Head of Equities at WealthClub.
